case_selection_rationale: Replicate 01 fixed in advance; one case per region family and small, medium, large customer scales. The set was named by the read-only consultant before any G2 result and may not be replaced after seeing outcomes.

gates.time_carbon_route_proxy: No strict loss to naive-EV on any case and at least one strict win.
gates.broad_mother_signal: Hybrid strictly beats both CV-only HGS and project ALNS on at least two of three cases.
gates.mechanism_split: At least one strict improvement over the frozen hybrid incumbent; otherwise stop this component.

no_rescue: Do not change seed, time, HGS share, or proxy constants after results.
Do not promote a tie against naive-EV as proof of time/carbon route pricing.
Do not count Split postprocessing time as equal-budget primary search.
